entities.summary: Sir George Gilbert Scott, largely known as Sir Gilbert Scott, was a prolific English Gothic Revival architect, chiefly associated with the design, building and renovation of churches and cathedrals, although he started his career as a leading designer of workhouses. Over 800 buildings were designed or altered by him. George Gilbert Scott was a architects & engineers from Gawcott (1811-07-13, Gawcott–1878-03-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
